channel.title: AI Frontier Post
channel.description: Dispatches from the AI frontier: AI news, research explainers, frontier lab coverage, and product comparisons.

item.title: Strawberry 1.0 is out of beta: Sweden's AI browser brings AI “companions” to non-technical teams
item.dc:creator: Marcus Doyle
item.description: Stockholm startup Strawberry launched version 1.0 of its AI browser on October 26, 2026, ending about a year in beta. Its AI “companions” learn a team's workflows and run jobs across the browser's tabs and logins, with a free tier and paid plans from $20 to $250 a month.

item.title: Meta plans a $95B equity raise to pay for its AI buildout — $35B now, $60B later
item.dc:creator: Marcus Doyle
item.description: Meta announced on October 26 concurrent underwritten offerings of about $35 billion — $22.5 billion of Class A stock and $12.5 billion of mandatory convertible preferred shares — plus a planned $60 billion at-the-market program, to fund AI infrastructure and personal superintelligence as its 2026 capital spending heads for $135–$145 billion.

item.title: GXO is putting Digit to work in two more warehouses: Agility's humanoid goes from one site to three
item.dc:creator: Marcus Doyle
item.description: GXO Logistics will deploy Agility Robotics' Digit humanoid at sites in North Carolina and Tennessee starting in early 2027, building on a Georgia deployment where Digit has already moved more than 100,000 totes — the clearest sign yet that warehouse humanoids are graduating from pilots to repeat orders.

item.title: AI agents breached Anthropic in under 12 hours — through its business software, not Claude
item.dc:creator: Marcus Doyle
item.description: Cathedral, a cybersecurity startup founded by former DOGE staffers, told Anthropic its AI agents reached internal sales, HR and IT systems in under 12 hours during a sanctioned security test, The Washington Post reported on October 26, 2026. Anthropic confirmed the access but disputes how far it went — and says Claude conversations, code and model weights were never reached.

item.title: Honeywell brings Forge Plant Cognition to Dangote's refinery, targeting $60M a year in AI gains
item.dc:creator: Marcus Doyle
item.description: Honeywell launched Forge Plant Cognition on October 26, 2026, at Dangote's Lekki refinery — an industrial AI platform built with NVIDIA AI and Dell infrastructure that Honeywell estimates could deliver more than 29 cents a barrel in operational benefit at full capacity.

item.title: Anthropic files its public S-1: Claude's maker heads for Nasdaq as ANT, with $16.3B in first-half revenue
item.dc:creator: Marcus Doyle
item.description: Anthropic publicly filed its Form S-1 on October 26, 2026, seeking a Nasdaq listing under the symbol ANT — disclosing $16.3 billion in first-half revenue alongside a headline $80.7 billion net loss driven mostly by accounting charges on convertible instruments.

item.title: Let Claude run a finite-element analysis: a hands-on guide to FieldCraft
item.dc:creator: Marcus Doyle
item.description: FieldCraft (tangency-labs/fieldcraft, Apache-2.0, 197 GitHub stars) is an open-source, pure-Rust engineering app that meshes parts, solves structural, thermal and fluid analyses, and lets an AI agent drive the whole thing over MCP. This guide installs the v0.7.0 build, connects Claude Code, and has it solve a steel I-beam cantilever — then checks its answer against beam theory.

item.title: Verovia goes live: Montréal's Verosoft brings governed AI orchestration to the factory floor
item.dc:creator: Marcus Doyle
item.description: Verosoft launched Verovia on October 26, 2026: a Microsoft-first AI orchestration platform that links industrial equipment, enterprise software and AI agents — with Entra ID governance, approval workflows and a free version to start.

item.title: Itaú buys NeoSpace AI for R$2.92B: Brazil's biggest bank bets on homegrown AI models
item.dc:creator: Marcus Doyle
item.description: Itaú Unibanco agreed on October 26, 2026 to buy AI startup NeoSpace AI for R$2.925 billion, folding the Large Data Model builder into Brazil's largest lender — and putting its generative AI platform i.ai at the center of the deal.

item.title: HKEX launches AI and semiconductor indices — and licenses the AI benchmark for a mainland ETF
item.dc:creator: Marcus Doyle
item.description: Hong Kong Exchanges and Clearing (HKEX) launched two new indices on October 26, 2026 — a 40-company AI index and a 30-company semiconductor index — and licensed the AI index to China Southern Asset Management for ETFs in mainland China.

item.title: fileAI signs AWS deal to bring outcome-driven AI agents to banks and insurers
item.dc:creator: Marcus Doyle
item.description: fileAI announced a strategic collaboration agreement with AWS on October 26, 2026, bringing fileForge AI agents built on Amazon Bedrock and sold through AWS Marketplace to banking, financial services and insurance leaders across Asia and the US.

item.title: SWI Compute exits stealth with 3.6 GW of power and ~$1B in NVIDIA orders for European AI factories
item.dc:creator: Marcus Doyle
item.description: SWI Compute, a new company inside Euronext Amsterdam-listed SWI Group, emerged from stealth on October 26, 2026, to build and operate NVIDIA AI factories starting in Europe, backed by 3.6 gigawatts of secured power capacity and about $1 billion in NVIDIA systems orders.

item.title: Lock your AI agent in a sandbox it can't talk its way out of: a hands-on guide to NVIDIA OpenShell
item.dc:creator: Marcus Doyle
item.description: NVIDIA OpenShell (NVIDIA/OpenShell, Apache-2.0, 19,936 GitHub stars) is a Rust runtime that puts each AI agent in a kernel-enforced sandbox with a declarative policy: no network, no files, no credentials unless the policy says so. This guide installs it, watches default-deny block a request, then opens exactly one read-only door to the GitHub API.

item.title: Ailytics raises $7.4M to turn old CCTV into an AI safety layer for heavy industry
item.dc:creator: Marcus Doyle
item.description: Singapore vision-AI startup Ailytics raised US$7.4 million in a Series A led by Tin Men Capital, growing from 70 projects in four countries to more than 400 deployments across 15 countries — by turning existing industrial CCTV into a real-time safety and operations layer.

item.title: Every AI quota in one glance: a hands-on guide to TokenBar
item.dc:creator: Marcus Doyle
item.description: TokenBar (lwh0630/TokenBar, MIT, 51 GitHub stars) is an open-source, cross-platform monitor for AI usage limits, balances and reset times: it reads the Codex, Claude and Cursor logins already on your machine, adds 47 more services by API key or cookie, and puts the tightest quota in your system tray. This guide installs the v1.0.0 build, adds your accounts, and sets up alerts and phone sync.

item.title: Claude's rough morning: Anthropic logs elevated errors across five models, twice before dawn
item.dc:creator: Marcus Doyle
item.description: Anthropic's status page logged elevated errors across five Claude models on October 25, 2026 — a 30-minute impact window in the early hours, then a second, shorter Fable 5.1 incident — with claude.ai, the API, Claude Code and Cowork marked as partial outages.

item.title: Give your coding agent a 3D studio: a hands-on guide to Blender Agent Skills
item.dc:creator: Marcus Doyle
item.description: Blender Agent Skills (EL4CTEO/blender-skills, MIT, 496 GitHub stars) packs 22 professional Blender 5.2 workflows — modeling, PBR, baking, rigging, animation, export and QA — into agent skills for Claude Code, Codex, Gemini CLI, Copilot and Cursor. This guide installs them, builds a game-ready crate, runs the QA pass, and exports it.

item.title: AI21’s LIFT-Bench scores the task, not just the rules — a new check on reward hacking
item.dc:creator: Marcus Doyle
item.description: AI21 Labs released LIFT-Bench on October 25, 2026, a benchmark that scores each constraint against only the document section it governs, alongside LIFT-Train, 34,258 training tasks that use the same score as the reinforcement-learning reward — so a model cannot earn full marks by deleting the task it was asked to do.

item.title: Build a phone agent on your own machine: a hands-on guide to Lampline
item.dc:creator: Marcus Doyle
item.description: Lampline (C4rohan/lampline, Apache-2.0, 272 GitHub stars) is an open-source, self-hosted voice-agent platform built on Pipecat: it imports Dialogflow CX agents, runs them on your own machine with local models and speech, and tests them with an AI caller that grades real phone calls. This guide starts it free, builds a front-desk agent, and runs the first graded eval.

item.title: HD Hyundai wins state backing for an AI excavator digital twin — test autonomy in simulation first
item.dc:creator: Marcus Doyle
item.description: HD Hyundai Site Solutions said on October 25, 2026 it will lead a South Korean state project to build a high-precision digital twin platform for AI autonomous excavators, a 6.33 billion won effort running through December 2029 that aims to validate driverless digging in virtual space before it reaches a real site.

item.title: Stop your coding agent writing stale API code: a hands-on guide to stalemap
item.dc:creator: Marcus Doyle
item.description: stalemap (Umair/stalemap, MIT, 103 GitHub stars) is a small tool that tells your coding agent which of your JavaScript or TypeScript dependencies changed after its training cutoff, writes the changes into a notes block your agent reads before it starts, and checks every edit against them. This guide previews the notes, writes them into your project, wires up the guard, and keeps the block fresh in CI.

item.title: Let your AI agent search your own WhatsApp history: a hands-on guide to whatsapp-mcp
item.dc:creator: Marcus Doyle
item.description: whatsapp-mcp (finereli/whatsapp-mcp, MIT, 359 GitHub stars) is a read-only MCP server that links to your phone the way WhatsApp Web does and lets Claude, ChatGPT or Grok search and read your own message history — it can never send anything. This guide deploys your own copy on Cloudflare, links your phone, and asks the first questions.

item.title: Axon Body 5: 25x the AI power, license scans, and real-time risk alerts for officers
item.dc:creator: Marcus Doyle
item.description: Axon announced Body 5 and Body 5 Pro on October 24, 2026: body cameras built to run AI on the device, with 25 times the AI processing power of earlier models, 20% more battery life, and a new Guardian feature that flags potential conflicts in real time.

item.title: Give your coding agent a map of your codebase: a hands-on guide to Graphicle
item.dc:creator: Marcus Doyle
item.description: Graphicle (Graphicle-AI/graphicle, Apache-2.0, 354 GitHub stars) is one Rust program that turns a repository into a code graph and a project memory — files, functions, calls, docs, decisions and past agent sessions — and serves both to your coding agent over a single MCP server, with no API key and no account. This guide installs it, indexes a repo, and asks it the first cited questions.

item.title: AI Ballot 2026: forced to choose, Grok picks the Republican 92% of the time and GPT picks the Democrat 97%
item.dc:creator: Marcus Doyle
item.description: Convovo's AI Ballot 2026 asked GPT-6.1 Sol and Grok 4.7 who to vote for in all 506 midterm races. The models disagreed in more than 90% of them — but the consumer apps refuse the question entirely.
